blind.description: A stylized square stone pillar or pedestal composed of three main sections: a stepped base, a rectangular shaft with recessed vertical panels on each side and dressed stone corner quoins, and an overhanging molded capital with a flat top. The lower third of the pillar exhibits a dark greenish water-stained or mossy coloration with dripping waterline marks, transitioning into dry brownish-grey masonry above. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and game-ready with hand-painted stylized stone textures.
blind.from_above: A square stone top divided into distinct paving segments, with four square corner stones and four inner trapezoidal segments tapering to meet at a central cross pattern.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly taller than the figure, approximately 6 to 6.5 ft tall; base footprint is roughly half the figure's height in width (about 2.5 to 3 ft wide).
